request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Which batteries are approaching end-of-life?","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"insight","restated_question":"Which devices in acme-001 have batteries approaching end-of-life, as defined by the battery_eol detector and the policy thresholds (e.g. battery health/capacity and cycle count limits)?","assumptions":["'Approaching end-of-life' is defined by the battery_eol detector and the thresholds in the organisation's policy, not by ad-hoc arithmetic.","Only devices with batteries (e.g. laptops) are relevant.","The admin wants a list of affected devices, not actions taken."],"steps":[{"tool":"get_policy","purpose":"Retrieve the battery end-of-life thresholds so the answer can state the definition used."},{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run the battery_eol detector to identify devices whose batteries are approaching end-of-life, with owner and supporting metrics."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
